# column space of a matrix　`def.column-space`
English entry · root `../`
[in graph](../#n=def.column-space)　·　[Chinese page (authoritative)](./def.column-space.md)

Row and column spaces have the same dimension (both equal the rank), but they are subspaces of different spaces; the link comes from transposition: $\operatorname{Col}(A) = \operatorname{Row}(A^{\mathsf T})$.

Rank–nullity: $\dim \operatorname{Col}(A) + \dim \ker A = n$.

> Proofs of the edges are still Chinese only: `proofs/`; the Chinese page remains authoritative.
